description: Get the user's contacts: Moneda users they interact with, saved external wallets, and saved bank accounts. Each wallet and bank entry has a contactAccountId field — pass it as the contactAccountId parameter to initiate_payment (transfer_contact_bank / transfer_contact_wallet). Use the contact's username (from the owner field or the username field) as contactUsername.

limit.description: Number of contacts to return (default: 20, max: 50)

offset.description: Number of contacts to skip for pagination

search.description: Search by username, display name, wallet name, or IBAN

name: get_contacts
